SELECT x.role AS role, COALESCE(SUM(x.amt), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT a.role AS role, CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'WIN' THEN t.amount WHEN t.transaction_type = 'LOSE' THEN -t.amount WHEN t.transaction_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END AS amt FROM transactions t INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo} AND t.transaction_type IN ('WIN', 'LOSE', 'ADJUSTMENT') AND UPPER(a.role) IN
UPPER(#{r})
UNION ALL
SELECT a.role AS role, -t.amount AS amt FROM transactions t INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo} AND t.transaction_type = 'PROFIT' AND UPPER(a.role) IN
UPPER(#{r})
UNION ALL
SELECT a.role AS role, t.amount AS amt FROM transactions t INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = t.from_account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo} AND t.transaction_type = 'PROFIT' AND UPPER(a.role) IN
UPPER(#{r})
) x GROUP BY x.role

SELECT x.role AS role, COALESCE(SUM(x.amt), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT a.role AS role, -t.amount AS amt FROM transactions t INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo} AND t.transaction_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'CLAIM', 'CONTRA', 'RATE') AND AND UPPER(a.role) IN
UPPER(#{r})
UNION ALL
SELECT a.role AS role, t.amount AS amt FROM transactions t INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = t.from_account_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo} AND t.transaction_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'CLAIM', 'CONTRA', 'RATE') AND AND UPPER(a.role) IN
UPPER(#{r})
) x GROUP BY x.role

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, account_id AS accountId, owner_type AS ownerType, partner_tenant_id AS partnerTenantId, percentage, read_only AS readOnly, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM tenant_ownership WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, effective_month AS effectiveMonth, account_id AS accountId, owner_type AS ownerType, partner_tenant_id AS partnerTenantId, percentage, read_only AS readOnly, saved_by AS savedBy, saved_at AS savedAt FROM tenant_ownership_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND effective_month = #{effectiveMonth} LIMIT 1
